names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 9 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νικηφόρος «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»», with the rank word left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026). saint.gr calls him a Russian saint and gives no life, so his own church's calendar is the source a later reader will want.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νικηφόρος «ὁ ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ»»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 9 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page gives no year and no life, so there is no `dates` object. The same calendar keeps a Luke «ὁ ἐν Σπηλαίῳ», also called Russian and also without a life, on 6 Νοεμβρίου. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
